BiblicalUsage: Ziphah is named once, as a son of Jehaleleel of the tribe of Judah and the brother of Ziph. He stands in the genealogy of Judah with no deed recorded beside his name. Like his brother, he is remembered because the line of Judah was worth keeping exactly.
TheologicalSignificance: Ziphah's one verse is enough for me: he belonged to Judah, and Judah's line led to Christ.
